result.title: Build Custom AI Infrastructure with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion
result.description:
Discover how NVIDIA NVLink Fusion enables hyperscalers, AI natives, and other custom silicon innovators to combine NVIDIA technology with their XPUs or CPUs to deploy AI infrastructure. 

By extending NVIDIA's vertically integrated and horizontally open platform across custom systems, NVLink Fusion delivers industry-leading scale-up performance, reduces deployment risk, and accelerates time to market for heterogeneous compute.

result.title: Building More Energy Efficient AI Factories With NVIDIA DSX
result.description:
AI factories are designed as integrated systems across grid, power, and cooling turning every megawatt into more intelligence.

Learn more: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/products/dsx/

result.title: NVIDIA Bionemo Inference Runtime
result.description:
NVIDIA BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BIR) 

Accelerates biomolecular structure prediction inference for models like OpenFold3 and Boltz-2 on NVIDIA H100 and H200 GPUs.

By optimizing discovery-scale workloads, BIR reduces the energy required to generate 31 million protein complex predictions for the AlphaFold Database by an estimated 1.35 GWh - the equivalent of 18,000 EV charges or 5.4 million electric vehicle miles.

GitHub - https://nvda.ws/3UKXFy4
Tech blog - https://nvda.ws/4dchK6H
